ctgov.note: Five trials sponsored by Reneo Pharma Ltd (legacy mavodelpar/REN001 program; deprioritized post-merger)

pipeline.modality: Oral small molecule, mutant-selective PI3Ka inhibitor

indications.indication: PI3Ka H1047R-mutated advanced solid tumors / metastatic breast cancer (HR+/HER2-, HER2+, HER2-low) — monotherapy and combinations with fulvestrant, ribociclib + fulvestrant, atirmociclib + fulvestrant, trastuzumab/tucatinib
indications.trial_design: Open-label, international, multi-arm Phase 1 dose escalation/expansion: monotherapy, doublet (OKI-219 + fulvestrant), and triplet arms (OKI-219 + fulvestrant + ribociclib; + atirmociclib)
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING; monotherapy and fulvestrant combination ongoing; two triplet dose escalation arms (Parts C and E) initiated H2 2025; combined data expected 2026
key_milestones: Preliminary safety/PK data Dec 2024 (well tolerated; no hyperglycemia)
Combined monotherapy + fulvestrant + triplet data expected 2026

excluded_preclinical.reason: Preclinical (IND-enabling studies ongoing) — mutant-selective PI3Ka for vascular anomalies
Preclinical (IND-enabling studies ongoing) — mutant-selective PI3Ka for breast cancer

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Legacy Reneo Pharma asset (pre-merger); Phase 2 STRIDE in primary mitochondrial myopathy (NCT04535609) completed; long-term study NCT05267574 TERMINATED; program deprioritized following Reneo/OnKure reverse merger; no longer in 10-K pipeline
Prior HDAC inhibitor program (NCT03931681 and NCT05340621 NAUTILUS combination with binimetinib in NRAS-mutated melanoma both COMPLETED); not described as active in 2025 10-K pipeline
